Messages.Author: Kushiel
Messages.Body: PB: Montreal seems iffy in here - you can't defend it, you won't have the spare actions to take it back until later in the game, and you're already making a bunch of pool. Did you find it useful (if you remember)?

Messages.Author: rayromanosucks
Messages.Body: I think I went first in the final with it in hand so getting malgorzata on turn 2 was relevant. But usually I would agree, no real way to defend it.

Messages.Author: Kushiel
Messages.Body: Did you have any issues playing Flames of the Netherworld and Breath of the Dragon? The former is only usable at long range, and the latter is basically the same, but there are only two maneuvers in the deck.

Messages.Author: rayromanosucks
Messages.Body: Definitely not at the final as I was facing down a toreador guns deck at the end. Otherwise it's an easy discard through the rest of the game.
